evidence.computation: Whole rectangular spacing cells: floor(row length in inches / plant spacing) times floor(bed width in inches / row spacing). Proved spacing-cell area does not exceed bed area.
assumptions: One full spacing cell per plant, with no border plants, paths or staggered layout.
For a nonsquare bed with unequal spacings, the question must name the side along which rows run; otherwise the request declines.
Dimensions are nonnegative and both spacings are positive.
untrusted: English recognition, physical dimension and row-role parsing, and JSON framing.

evidence.computation: Fixed human anatomy table with typed age applicability for counts. The stage-aware request can only preserve the original count or decline; it cannot invent a different count.
assumptions: The source describes standard human anatomy, not an individual medical condition.
Explicit developmental context is applied to skeletal and dentition counts; an unsupported stage does not inherit the adult count.
untrusted: Source facts, English recognition and framing.
